source: Made for this study (not a tau-bench task), on tau-bench's retail data
why_chosen: A short, read-only smoke test for real LLMs: 2 tool calls (identify the customer, read the order), no data changes, and an exact answer to check. Few LLM calls, so it stays within free-tier API rate limits.
goal: A customer, Aarav Anderson (zip code 19031), asks about their order #W9300146: what is its current status, and how much did they pay for it? Only look this up; do not change anything.
